types.name: ratelimit.v1.GetRateLimitConfigRequest
types.doc:
GetRateLimitConfigRequest requests the complete active public trading
 rate-limit catalog.

types.name: ratelimit.v1.GetRateLimitConfigResponse
types.doc:
GetRateLimitConfigResponse contains all placement, cancellation and read
 rules for one complete policy version.

fields.name: policy_version
fields.doc: Positive identifier of the returned rate-limit policy version.

fields.name: effective_from
fields.doc: UTC time at which this policy version became effective.

fields.name: rules
fields.doc:
Complete placement, cancellation and read catalog. Rules are ordered by
 policy class (cancellation, placement, read), then by tier ascending. The
 list contains one rule per class for each VIP0 through VIP10 tier and is
 not paginated.

types.name: ratelimit.v1.GetTradingRateLimitsRequest
types.doc:
GetTradingRateLimitsRequest requests the effective trading limits for one
 account target.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional public subaccount ID. When omitted, subaccount-scoped API keys
 use their bound subaccount; other callers use their authenticated root
 account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: ratelimit.v1.GetTradingRateLimitsResponse
types.doc:
GetTradingRateLimitsResponse contains the placement, cancellation and read
 limits enforced for the selected account target. All three limits apply per
 account: the root account and each subaccount have their own limits, and
 every API key and session that trades or reads for an account shares that
 account's limits.

fields.name: policy_version
fields.doc:
Positive identifier of the rate-limit policy version used for the
 returned rules.

fields.name: effective_from
fields.doc: UTC time at which this policy version became effective.

fields.name: rules
fields.doc:
Placement, cancellation and read rules enforced for the selected
 account, ordered placement, cancellation, read. All of the account's API
 keys and sessions draw on these limits together.

fields.name: api_key_rules
fields.doc:
Placement, cancellation and read rules resolved for the calling API key,
 ordered placement, cancellation, read. Present only when the caller
 authenticated with an API key. The read rule is enforced per API key on
 top of the account's read limit: a read or preview is refused when either
 is exhausted. The placement and cancellation rules are informational:
 orders are limited per account only, by the account rules in `rules`.

types.name: ratelimit.v1.TradingRateLimitClass
types.doc: TradingRateLimitClass identifies a public trading operation family.

values.name: TRADING_RATE_LIMIT_CLASS_READ
values.doc:
Order, fill, trigger, trading-limit and fee reads, and order previews.
 Each account has its own read limit: the root account and each
 subaccount separately, shared by every API key and session that reads
 for that account.

types.name: ratelimit.v1.TradingRateLimitRule
types.doc:
TradingRateLimitRule describes one weighted placement, cancellation or read
 quota for one VIP tier.

fields.name: policy_class
fields.doc:
Trading operation family governed by this rule. Public responses contain
 TRADING_RATE_LIMIT_CLASS_PLACE, TRADING_RATE_LIMIT_CLASS_CANCEL or
 TRADING_RATE_LIMIT_CLASS_READ.

fields.name: vip_tier
fields.doc: VIP tier for this rule, in the inclusive range 0 through 10.

fields.name: quota_weight
fields.doc:
Weighted request capacity available during each policy period. One
 operation consumes the weight assigned to that operation.

fields.name: burst_weight
fields.doc: Maximum weighted capacity that may be consumed in a burst.
